title: Best Beach Destinations in India, by Coast and Travel Style
excerpt: A guide to the best beach destinations in India, the places to base a beach holiday: Goa, the Andaman and Lakshadweep islands, Kerala's Varkala and Kovalam, Gokarna and the Udupi coast, the Konkan coast, Puducherry and Mahabalipuram, Puri, Vizag, Diu and Digha, compared by coast, season, budget and type of traveller.
imageAlt: A mangrove tree on a white-sand beach, Havelock Island, Andamans

title: Best Beaches in India: The Standout Beaches, Coast by Coast
excerpt: A guide to India's standout individual beaches, coast by coast: Radhanagar and Elephant Beach in the Andamans, Bangaram in Lakshadweep, Palolem, Agonda and Vagator in Goa, Om and Kudle in Gokarna, Varkala and Kovalam in Kerala, Tarkarli and Kashid in Maharashtra, Shivrajpur and Nagoa on the Gujarat coast, and Rushikonda, Puri and Paradise Beach on the east coast, with India's Blue Flag beaches.
imageAlt: Driftwood on Radhanagar Beach, Havelock Island, Andamans

title: Beach Holidays in India: How to Choose by Traveller, Budget and Season
excerpt: A planning guide to beach holidays in India: which coast suits couples, families, solo travellers and groups, luxury and budget beach holidays, the main types of beach trip (party, quiet, resort, island, heritage, active), how long to stay, what drives the cost, and packing.
imageAlt: The lighthouse above Lighthouse beach, Kovalam, Kerala

title: Beach Trips in India: Short Breaks from Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata and Delhi
excerpt: A guide to short beach trips from India's big cities: Alibaug, Kashid and the Konkan from Mumbai and Pune, Gokarna, Udupi and Pondicherry from Bengaluru, Covelong, Mahabalipuram and Pondicherry from Chennai, Vizag from Hyderabad, Digha and Puri from Kolkata, Diu and Shivrajpur from Ahmedabad, and fly-in beach weekends from Delhi.
imageAlt: Sunset at Kashid beach, Raigad, Maharashtra

title: Beach Tourism in India: Blue Flag Beaches, Coastal Rules and Responsible Travel
excerpt: An explainer on beach tourism in India: what Blue Flag certification means and which beaches hold it, the government's BEAMS programme, how coastal regulation shapes beach shacks and resorts, monsoon bans and lifeguard services, protection for nesting turtles and coral reefs, plastic rules, and how visitors can travel responsibly.
imageAlt: Shivrajpur beach near Dwarka, Gujarat

title: Coastal Tourism in India: Backwaters, Lighthouses, Forts and Fishing Villages
excerpt: A guide to coastal tourism in India beyond the beach: Kerala's backwaters, sea forts from Janjira to Sindhudurg and Bekal, lighthouses opened to visitors, mangrove forests such as the Sundarbans, Bhitarkanika and Pichavaram, fishing harbours and villages, coastal road trips, cruises, coastal cuisine and seasonal festivals.
imageAlt: Chinese fishing nets in the water at Fort Kochi, Kerala

title: Best Beaches in Goa: North and South Goa Beach by Beach
excerpt: A beach-by-beach guide to Goa's coast: the lively beaches of north Goa (Calangute, Baga, Anjuna, Vagator, Arambol), the quieter beaches of south Goa (Palolem, Agonda, Colva, Benaulim, Cavelossim), hidden coves, turtle-nesting beaches, the best season, monsoon rules and how to choose a base.
imageAlt: The bay at Vagator and Chapora, north Goa

title: Best Beaches in the Andaman Islands: Havelock, Neil, Port Blair and Beyond
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches in the Andaman Islands: Radhanagar, Kalapathar, Elephant and Vijaynagar beaches on Swaraj Dweep (Havelock), Laxmanpur, Bharatpur and Sitapur on Shaheed Dweep (Neil), Corbyn's Cove, Chidiya Tapu and Wandoor near Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), and remote beaches in North and Little Andaman, with seasons and safety.
imageAlt: Boats off Kalapathar beach, Havelock Island

title: Best Beaches in Lakshadweep: Islands, Lagoons and Permits
excerpt: A guide to the beaches of Lakshadweep, India's coral atolls in the Arabian Sea: the lagoons of Agatti, Bangaram, Kadmat, Kavaratti and Minicoy, which islands visitors can reach, the entry permit, flights and ships from Kochi, the season and how to protect the reef.
imageAlt: Thatched huts under palms on Bangaram Island, Lakshadweep

title: Best Beaches in Kerala: From Varkala and Kovalam to the Malabar Coast
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches in Kerala, south to north: Kovalam, Poovar and Varkala near Thiruvananthapuram, Marari and Alappuzha near the backwaters, Cherai and Fort Kochi, Kappad near Kozhikode, and Muzhappilangad, Payyambalam, Chal and Bekal on the Malabar coast, with seasons and sea-safety rules.
imageAlt: Varkala beach seen from the cliff, Kerala

title: Best Beaches in Karnataka: Gokarna, Udupi, Murudeshwar and Karwar
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches on Karnataka's 320-km coast: Gokarna's beach trek (Kudle, Om, Half Moon, Paradise), Murudeshwar and the Netrani dive trips, Udupi's Malpe, St Mary's Island, Kaup and Padubidri, the Maravanthe road, Karwar and Devbagh, and Mangaluru's beaches, with seasons and safety.
imageAlt: Waves on Murudeshwar beach, Karnataka

title: Best Beaches in Maharashtra: Konkan Coast from Alibaug to Tarkarli
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches on Maharashtra's Konkan coast, from Alibaug, Nagaon and Kashid near Mumbai to Murud-Janjira, Diveagar, Shrivardhan and Harihareshwar, the Blue Flag beaches of Guhagar and Ladghar, Velas and its turtles, Ganpatipule, and Tarkarli, Devbagh and Malvan in Sindhudurg, with seasons, access and safety.
imageAlt: The temple on Ganpatipule beach, Ratnagiri

title: Best Beaches in Tamil Nadu: Chennai, Mahabalipuram, Rameswaram and Kanyakumari
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches on Tamil Nadu's long coast: Chennai's city beaches, Kovalam (Covelong) and Mahabalipuram on the East Coast Road, Tranquebar and Velankanni on the delta coast, Rameswaram and Dhanushkodi, and Kanyakumari at India's southern tip, with the north-east monsoon, swimming rules and when to go.
imageAlt: Beach near Dhanushkodi, Rameswaram island, Tamil Nadu

title: Best Beaches in Odisha: Puri, Chandrabhaga, Gopalpur and Chandipur
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches on Odisha's Bay of Bengal coast: Puri's Blue Flag Golden Beach and sand art, Chandrabhaga and Ramchandi near Konark, Gopalpur and Sunapur in Ganjam, Chandipur where the sea recedes at low tide, Talasari near the Bengal border, and the olive ridley nesting coast, with cyclone season and swimming advice.
imageAlt: The sea at Gopalpur beach, Odisha

title: Best Beaches in Gujarat: Shivrajpur, Mandvi, Dwarka and the Saurashtra Coast
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches on Gujarat's long coast: Shivrajpur near Dwarka with Blue Flag certification and snorkelling, Mandvi in Kutch, the temple shores of Dwarka and Somnath, Chorwad, Ahmedpur Mandvi near Diu, Tithal and Dumas in south Gujarat, and the beaches of Diu and Daman just across the Union Territory border.
imageAlt: Camel ride at sunset on Mandvi beach, Kutch

title: Best Beaches in Andhra Pradesh: Visakhapatnam's Coast and Beyond
excerpt: A guide to the best beaches in Andhra Pradesh, focusing on Visakhapatnam: RK Beach, the Blue Flag beach at Rushikonda with water sports, Yarada below Dolphin's Nose, Bheemili at the Gosthani river mouth, and the coastal road between them, plus Suryalanka and other beaches down the coast, with cyclone season and safety.
imageAlt: Rocks and surf at Rushikonda beach, Visakhapatnam

title: Best Beaches in West Bengal: Digha, Mandarmani, Tajpur and Bakkhali
excerpt: A guide to West Bengal's beaches on the Bay of Bengal: Old and New Digha, Mandarmani's long beach, the fishing harbour at Shankarpur, quiet Tajpur and Junput, Bakkhali and Frasergunj near the Sundarbans, and Gangasagar, with travel times from Kolkata, the best season and sea-bathing restrictions.
imageAlt: Tajpur beach and its casuarina trees, West Bengal

title: Best Beaches in Puducherry: Paradise, Serenity, Auroville and Rock Beach
excerpt: A guide to Puducherry's beaches: the Promenade (Rock Beach) in the French Quarter, Paradise Beach reached by boat from Chunnambar, Serenity Beach for surf lessons, Auroville's beaches and Eden beach at Chinna Veerampattinam, with which are for swimming and which for walks, and the best season.
imageAlt: The entrance to Paradise Beach, Puducherry

title: Dolphin Watching in India: Where to See Dolphins on the Coast
excerpt: A guide to dolphin watching in India: boat trips to see humpback dolphins off Goa (Sinquerim, Coco Beach, Palolem) and the Konkan (Tarkarli, Devbagh, Dapoli), Irrawaddy dolphins at Satapada on Chilika Lake, river dolphins in the Sundarbans and the Ganga, the best seasons, what to expect and how to choose a responsible operator.
imageAlt: A dolphin-watching boat on Chilika Lake, Odisha

title: Beach Honeymoon Destinations in India
excerpt: A guide to beach honeymoons in India: why the Andaman Islands (Havelock and Neil) and Lakshadweep top the list, south Goa's quiet bays, Kerala's cliff, lighthouse and estuary beaches paired with the backwaters, Gokarna, Pondicherry, and quieter Konkan and Diu options, with seasons, trip lengths and planning tips.
imageAlt: Boats in clear water off Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep), Andamans

title: Offbeat Beaches in India: Quiet Coasts Worth the Detour
excerpt: A guide to offbeat beaches in India, quieter alternatives to the famous names: Guhagar, Velas and Devbagh on the Konkan, Galgibaga and Cola in Goa, Kasarkod, Maravanthe and Devbagh (Karwar) in Karnataka, Marari, Kappil and Muzhappilangad in Kerala, Tranquebar in Tamil Nadu, Yarada and Bheemili in Andhra, Talasari and Junput on the Bengal border, and remote island beaches.
imageAlt: Kudle beach seen from the headland, Gokarna

title: Best Time for Beach Holidays in India, Month by Month
excerpt: A month-by-month guide to beach holidays in India: when the west coast, the east coast, the Andamans and Lakshadweep are at their best, what the south-west and north-east monsoons mean for swimming, where to go in December, January and February, summer beach options, turtle seasons and festivals.
imageAlt: Palolem beach, south Goa

title: Beach Safety in India: Flags, Rip Currents, Monsoon Rules and Marine Life
excerpt: A practical guide to beach safety in India: why swimming is riskier than it looks, how lifeguard flags work, how to spot and escape a rip current, monsoon and cyclone bathing bans, beaches where swimming is prohibited, tides, rocks and cliffs, jellyfish and marine life, crocodile warnings in the Andamans, water-sports safety, sun and alcohol, and what to do in an emergency.
imageAlt: Lifeguards and their patrol vehicle on a Goa beach
